title: Entitled Lady Goes Nuts After Police Arrest Her Boyfriend (Police Bodycam)
description:
On December 16th, 2023, officers responded to a disturbance. Dispatch advised that a woman and her boyfriend had gotten into an altercation outside a casino. Although the officers had arrested her boyfriend, the woman continued to act aggressively. The female continued to act in an aggressive manner even after the officers had released her. The female kept escalating the matter even though she had the option to leave. The woman rejected all the help that the officers offered. Soon, the female started driving away and was stopped by the officers. The woman continued to argue and yell at the officer even while being transported to the jail. The woman showed no signs of stopping her aggressive behavior. The female was charged with DUI, Open container and Resisting arrest.
